{{Character|name=Male Sorcerer|image=File: 二阶-男术.png}}{{Character|name=Female Sorcerer|image=File: 二阶-女术士.png}}

== OVERVIEW ==
Destroyers who command the power of the elements, excelling in sweeping the battlefield with magnificent magical storms. With a staff and grimoire in hand, they can pour out devastatingly high damage in the blink of an eye.

Hailed as a walking elemental torrent on the battlefield, every spell they cast inflicts heavy trauma on the enemy, making them the most dazzling core of firepower within any team.

While their '''DEF''' is relatively low, they leverage agile movement and precise control over the battlefield to launch attacks from a safe distance. Whether clearing out minor mobs or focusing a concentrated bombardment on powerful foes, the '''Sorcerer''' is an undisputed expert.

When multiple elemental powers intertwine and explode across the battlefield, it is their moment to shine brightest.
